% 21.04.2023 [Physical Hearing/ Hybrid Hearing] CM APPL. 19999/2023 (Application under Section 151 CPC for exemption from filing certified copies/dim copies/typed copies and official translation of the annexures)
1. This is an application under Section 151 CPC for exemption from filing certified copies/dim copies/typed copies and official translation of the annexures.
2. Recording the undertaking on behalf of the appellants that defects shall be cured within four weeks, exemption is allowed.
3. Application is disposed of.

CM APPL. 19959/2023 (Application on behalf of the appellants under Order 23 Rule 3 read with Section 151 CPC for recalling the impugned order dated 22.07.1991 based on alleged Lok Adalat settlement dated 07.07.1991 and declaring the decree dated 22.07.1991 passed in the present appeal as null and void) & CM APPL. 19998/2023 (Application under Section 17 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay in filing the application under Section 151 CPC for recalling of impugned order dated 22.07.1991)
4.
CM APPL. 19959/2023 has been filed on behalf of the appellants with prayer for re-calling the order dated 22.07.1991 passed by this Court, based on the Lok Adalat Settlement dated 07.07.1991.

There is further prayer for declaring the decree dated 22.07.1991 passed in the present appeal, as null and void and for further prayer that other subsequent proceedings emanating therefrom, also Mahabir Singh & Ors vs Union Of India & Ors on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173892343/
1 be declared as null and void.

sentences.text:
5. It is the case on behalf of the appellants that the appellants and their other brothers were the owners in possession of the agricultural land falling in Khasra No.501 min, 1127-1128/502, 503 min,
504 min, 460 min, 1034/496 min, 851 min, 901 min, 830, 771, 385, 425, 434, 1021/719, 435 and 376 situated in the revenue estate of Village Gokul Pur, Shahdara, Delhi, total measuring 24 Bighas and 10 Biswas approximately.
6. Along with the aforesaid land of the appellants, huge chunk of land of other villages were also acquired by the respondent vide award No. 2004 dated 20.09.1967 of Village Gokul Pur, Delhi.

7. It is submitted that being aggrieved by the low assessment of compensation by the Land Acquisition Collector (LAC), the appellants filed reference petition under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, along with their deceased brothers.

Learned ADJ vide order dated 04.04.1978,
passed an order enhancing the compensation.
Since, the appellants were not satisfied with the enhanced compensation as granted by the learned Reference Court, the present appeal came to be filed by the appellants in the year 1978.

8. It is submitted that the order dated 07.07.1991 passed by this Court shows that the appellants have compromised/settled the matter in Lok Adalat, on the basis of which this Court vide order dated 22.07.1991 passed a decree in terms of the alleged Lok Adalat settlement.

9. It is submitted that in the present case, a fraud was committed by the respondents, which the appellants discovered only on 11.01.2023, when the appellants received certified copy of the alleged Lok Adalat settlement dated 07.07.1991.
10.
It is submitted that the respondents played fraud upon the appellants in connivance with their previous counsel and fraudulently obtained a decree dated 22.07.1991.
It is submitted that appellants herein neither signed any settlement nor participated in any proceedings before the Lok Adalat.

11. Thus, it is submitted that the case of the appellants is covered by a recent judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court dated 24.09.2022, titled as Vipan Aggarwal & Anr. Vs. Raman Gandotra & Ors., in Civil Appeal No. 3492/2022..

entities.text: Vipan Aggarwal & Anr. Vs. Raman Gandotra & Ors

19998/2023 has been filed for condonation of delay.
13. Issue notice.
14. Notice is accepted by learned counsel appearing for the respondent/Land Acquisition Collector.

15. Let notice be issued to the other respondents.
